summary.text: Michael Friend, also known as Mike, is the Democratic candidate for Florida House of Representatives District 102 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Mery Lopez-Palma in a race with no incumbent.
A dentist, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to make healthcare more affordable and accessible and to support teachers and students.

paragraphs.text: Michael Friend earned a high school diploma from Hollywood Hills High School and a graduate degree from the University of Pennsylvania School of Dental Medicine in 2001.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a first-generation American born in Hollywood, Florida, and that he moved back to District 102 after graduating, where he and his wife built a home and a business and raised three children.

He said he serves on the Circle of Impact Advisory Board at NSU College of Dental Medicine and the Town of Davie Public Art Advisory Committee, and is a Legislative Contact Dentist for the Florida Dental Association.
Friend won the August 18, 2026 Democratic primary with 52.2% of the vote (6,766 votes), defeating Jayden D'Onofrio.
In the survey, he listed affordable healthcare, support for teachers and safer schools, and affordability, including insurance reform and housing, as his key messages.
